scoring: Original user1/full fixed S path/speed request; strict native task, goal, survival and costs separately per case.
data_role: Familiar nominal DEV, shared H75 ancestor; fixed.5/1 cached not rerun.
interpretation: Hybrid out-of-training action combinations; not deployable scalar-alpha coordinator; no speed-matched causal claim.
comparison: Compare each hybrid against both fixed.5 and fixed1 on each same context, including strict task, goal, contact/domain/fault, user1 total/task costs, observed speed and path errors; retain losses and observation length. No automatic adoption.
stop_rule: Exactly8/H10/maximum16000lower;0optimizer/force/replanning; native stops, preserve partial raw and stop on engineering error; no implicit retries or expansion.

exploratory_falsification_rules.speed_half_steer_one: Covers fixed.5 only if all four contexts pass strict native task and both per-route original-user1 total and task-channel costs <=1.05*fixed.5+0.1. This weakens necessity of the changed steering mapping in these nominal contexts only.
exploratory_falsification_rules.speed_one_steer_half: Improves fixed1 only if tight-context strict gains occur with no strict losses elsewhere. Report both costs and actual speed changes; no claim of force tolerance or speed-matched causal effect.
exploratory_falsification_rules.negative: Two failing hybrids do not alone establish coordination necessity; out-of-training pairing and closed-loop speed changes remain limitations.
exploratory_falsification_rules.followup: No threshold or route reruns, automatic MLP training, implicit retries or automatic adoption. Engineering failure stops and retains partial raw.
